A fresh, complete, zero-write inventory (all 270 observations, 9 workouts) confirms the deferred-Cardio backlog is still exactly 4 Apple-type-52 walks (2 Sep23 America/Los_Angeles, 2 Sep24 America/Chicago), all classify cardio/walking under the deployed classifier, none stores isIndoorWorkout (Indoor/Outdoor not recoverable, not inferred), none canonicalized; no new Sep25+ workouts. The workout policy was freshly re-read: Strength-only, digest dc7ba152cf5e9dd528e380bed6bc0366, version 3, effective 2026-09-23, openEnded, quarantined, no backfill, no auto-confirm — Cardio NOT active. The atomic replace-families dry-run (strength -> [cardio,strength]) returned outcome dry_run, predicting exactly the policy update plus one audit row and preserving every non-family field; an independent post-dry-run read proved zero writes (policy, six HealthKit collections, 9 workout rows, 35 strategic digests all identical). Gate 5 APPLY is recommended, pending Founder authorization; a fresh dry-run must be taken immediately before apply because the drift fence hashes the full observation collection.
